Noah's Ark 1959
programme.desc: Noah gets the word: build an ark in seven days. His sons cut the necessary trees in three days, and much furious sawing and hammering follows. But there's no rest, as they need to round up all the animals. Noah boards the animals, then his sons, their wives, and his wife (who packed a ferocious picnic). The rains and flood begin. The animals soon develop cabin fever and get restless, but Mrs. Noah has the answer: "Music has charms to soothe the savage beast." His sons find instruments and begin playing; everyone dances. But Harry the hippo dances with everyone but his wife; Noah goes to her, and while she tells him not to mention Harry's name, Noah convinces her that Harry is thinking only of her. The rains end; Noah sends a dove out who brings back an olive branch. They land on Mount Ararat and disembark.

The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China’s most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.sub-title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.1
programme.desc: Yunnan straddles the Hengduan Mountains and Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, revealing Kawagarbo Peak, vibrant Lijiang, and Hani's golden terraces. Come fly with us on a quest for the essence of Yunnan and discover why it so richly deserves its name - Yunnan, 'the Land South of the Clouds'!

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.sub-title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: Lost Worlds: Vanished Lives

programme.title: Lost Worlds: Vanished Lives

programme.title: Lost Worlds: Vanished Lives

programme.desc: Discover the beasts of the Ice Age with Professor Alice Roberts. Alice's adventure begins in the Land of the Sabre-tooth.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Alice ventures to the parts of the northern hemisphere hit hardest by the cold - Europe and Siberia. High in the mountains of Transylvania, a cave sealed for thousands of years reveals grisly evidence of a fight to the death.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts journeys 40,000 years back in time on the trail of the great beasts of the ice age. This was the last time that giants like mammoths, woolly rhinos and sabre-toothed cats ruled our planet.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Special effects-filled documentary beginning 49 million years ago. The world is heavily forested and birds rule the planet, preying on small mammals. Whales have not yet evolved and their ancestors walk on the land.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: A pregnant basilosaurus, an 18-metre, carnivorous whale which lives in the Tethys Sea, is forced to kill the young of a smaller whale to ensure the survival of her unborn calf.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Going back 25 million years to the time of the indricothere, which was the largest mammal ever to live on dry land, being seven metres high and weighing 15 tons! The only threat to an adult would have been the hyaenadon which was the size of a rhino.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: The beginnings of mankind can be traced back 3.2 million years to Ethiopia and the advent of Australopithecus, a type of ape which, like humans, was bipedal. These early members of the human family faced many dangers, including the sabre-toothed cat.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Revealing the exotic, oversized creatures that inhabited South America one million years ago, such as the deadly smilodon, the largest of all sabre tooth cats.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Looking at the depths of the Ice Age, following a group of mammoths who have been forced to travel south with the advent of winter. On a dangerous journey across the Alps, many become trapped in bogs or fall victim to predators.

programme.title: Natural World

We will start this episode from Brazil where the Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazilâs north-east coast, launching its season finale. We will also travel to Turkey, where the Bosphorus turned into a sea of color and pride as the 6th Presidential International Yacht Races concluded with its grand finale. Leaving action aside, we will travel to Malta for for the Malta Boat Show.

programme.title: Hunting Fish S1 - "Gran Canaria - Part Two"
programme.desc: Thom Hunt daagt zichzelf uit om op wilde tonijn te vissen in het prachtige Gran Canaria.

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - "Bay of Islands Exploration"
programme.desc: The fellas set off to tick a box for rookie spearo Ants, aiming to bag him his first ever kingfish, before shifting focus to landing a few more prized fish in some stunning Bay of Islands blue water, but as it doesn't all go according to plan!

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - "South Minerva Reef"
programme.desc: The team embark on their biggest mission to date, an expedition to the remote and revered Minerva Reefs, where they encounter the most incredible diving conditions they've ever experienced, but also, a thriving population of voracious sharks!

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 - "Birds of a Feather"
programme.desc: Mario geniet van zijn vriendschappen en de uitdagende eendenjacht op de openingsdag. Hij leert het publiek hoe je een eeuwenoud Chinees recept bereidt samen met een van de chef-koks van een bekroond restaurant in Nieuw-Zeeland.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S2 - "Man Eating Crocs"
programme.desc: Mario riskeert alles en gaat met een vlot de dodelijkste rivier in Afrika af, de Zambezi rivier. Hij drijft richting het Kariba meer, en komt daar oog in oog te staan met één van de grootste en meest problematische mensetende krokodillen ter wereld.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "NEVER GIVE UP"
programme.desc: Mike Johnson en zijn zoon blijven hoopvol uitkijken naar die grote vangst, terwijl Tim Adams en zijn bemanning op het water hun eigen, unieke uitdagingen trotseren.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "IDENTITY CRISIS"
programme.desc: Het is de eerste week van april in het noordelijke Midwesten. Onze vissers mikken op recordvangsten nu de markt nog hoge prijzen biedt.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "THE NEW GENERATION"
programme.desc: Iedereen krijgt te maken met zware omstandigheden: Mike en zijn zoon hard werken in Lake Pepin, Jedd en zijn vader botsen voortdurend in Wisconsin, en Tim gaat met een nieuwkomer het water op – maar keert vrijwel met lege handen terug.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1 - "Desperate Times"
programme.desc: Island Air zet een groep wanhopige jagers af in het hart van de bush terwijl een strenge vorst Kodiak treft.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1 - "Risky Business"
programme.desc: Piloot Peter Rosendahl bestrijdt stormwinden en woelige zeeën terwijl hij een groep jagers naar een drijvend hotel vervoert.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1 - "Training Day"
programme.desc: Nieuwe piloten worden op de proef gesteld. Hebben zij in huis wat nodig is om voor Island Air te vliegen?

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Dump Site"
programme.desc: De wachters van Regio 4 vinden een hert in de vuilnisbak, meerdere herten langs de weg gedumpt en een hert achtergelaten door een indringer. Het hoort allemaal bij een lange werkdag!

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Hidden Truth"
programme.desc: Wanneer de wachters in de eerste week van november een vrachtwagen stoppen met kerstbomen in de achterbak, weten ze dat er iets verborgen wordt. Waarschijnlijk de waarheid!

programme.title: Wardens S6 - "Back Country"
programme.desc: De wachters doen veel meer dan alleen maar rondrijden in vrachtwagens en het controleren van vergunningen. Deze week gaan de wachters van Regio 1 off-grid om de natuurlijke hulpbronnen van Montana te beschermen.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Arluk Outfitter's"
programme.desc: We keren terug naar de beroemde Main River in het noorden van Newfoundland om te vliegvissen op wilde Atlantische zalm.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Carolyn Beach Motel"
programme.desc: Alyx Parks en Colin McKeown maken een doe-het-zelf-vistrip vroeg in het seizoen om grote pre-spawn smallmouth bass te vinden.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Cree River Lodge"
programme.desc: Jenna & Alyx bezoeken het noorden van Saskatchewan om met een vlieg op reusachtige snoeken en snoekbaarzen te vissen. Daar vangen ze een nieuwe IGFA-recordvis!

programme.title: Hunting Fish S1 - "Norway"
programme.desc: Thom Hunt daagt zichzelf uit om in de vrieskou op kabeljauw te vissen in het pittoreske Noorwegen.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Driven in France"
programme.desc: Rijk aan overvloed en geschiedenis, de heuvels rond Kayserberg, Elzas, zijn vol met wildlife. Twee vrienden gaan op pad om een systeem te bouwen om die overvloed te delen met de rest van Frankrijk, van bos tot vork!

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Follow the Fallow"
programme.desc: Na twee jaar wachten mogen damherten eindelijk worden bejaagd op nieuwe jachtgronden hoog in de Italiaanse Apennijnen.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Feathers & Fur"
programme.desc: De wind waait voortdurend vanuit het westen op het eiland Fanø in Denemarken. Neem de ferry om over te steken, om houtduiven en konijnen te jagen met Jesper, zijn hond en zijn fret.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: Anthony wil zijn rol als medisch leidinggevende bewijzen tijdens een reddingsoperatie rond een sneeuwscooterongeluk op Togwotee Pass.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: Tijdens elke missie heeft de veiligheid van het team de hoogste prioriteit. Dus wanneer de omstandigheden op Pyramid Peak Jake en Cody in een lastig parket brengen tijdens een reddingsoperatie, eist Tim dat ze het rustig aan doen.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: Jake en Marilynn zeggen een etentje af om een gewonde skiër op Teton Pass in veiligheid te stellen.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "The Best Of"
programme.desc: Travel across the continent, exploring the opulent villas, luxurious palaces, remote command centers, underground tunnels, and secret bunkers of Europe’s most tyrannical dictators.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac"
programme.sub-title: An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac
programme.desc: What starts off as a seven-pound bar of solid steel will soon deliver a bullet with deadly accuracy when it becomes the barrel of a Colt C7 assault rifle, and when plastic and bulletproof fabric are molded and stitched together,they’ll make a suit of armour made for the most dangerous job in the world.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter"
programme.sub-title: A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter
programme.desc: As lightweight aluminum is cut and tooled, it will become the frame of a personal flying machine. Used by military operatives, drug enforcement agents, and first responders – it gets you in and out fast, whether you are carrying a camera or a gun.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs"
programme.sub-title: A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs
programme.desc: In 48 hours, a block of metal will be formed into the most accurate weapon on earth: the AX-338 Sniper Rifle. In a warzone, police stand off, or hostage taking, the sniper is often the only solution to a bad situation.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
programme.sub-title: An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft
programme.desc: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.sub-title: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programme.sub-title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
programme.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.sub-title: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.sub-title: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
programme.sub-title: An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition
programme.desc: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV"
programme.sub-title: Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV
programme.desc: Developed from solidified vegetable oil, this military grade compound is a long way from department store concealer: it’s sweat proof, infrared resistant, and stays on in the drenching downpour. For soldiers, especially Special Ops and snipers, camo paint completes their covert coverage.

programme.title: Disruptive Behaviour
programme.desc: Reuben Christian travels to Istanbul to meet the innovators who are changing the city and discover how technology is disrupting the old order.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Penrose Triangle and The Brain Illusion Pareidolia"
programme.sub-title: Penrose Triangle and The Brain Illusion Pareidolia
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems we’ll take a look at impossible objects such as the penrose triangle, the brain illusion pareidolia and explore the phenomenon of levitation.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Magic of Newtonian Fluids"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems we’ll explain optical illusions like forced perspective, introduce you to the magic of Newtonian fluids and take an in - depth look at the magic bed of nails trick.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Grandfather Paradox and Time Travel"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s explain Ambigram’s and how they trick you plus we’ll discover the Grandfather paradox and the question of time travel. Finally we’ll put your ears to the test with the Shepard Tone illusion.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "McGurk Effect Phenomenon"
programme.desc: Lets take a look at the art movement photorealism and another test for your ears in the McGurk Effect phenomenon. We’ll take you back in time to introduce you to Peppers ghost and highlight famous forward thinker Leonardo Da Vinci.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Zeno’s paradox and The UV - A Blacklight"
programme.sub-title: Zeno’s paradox and The UV - A Blacklight
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll take a look at magician’s trade secrets, the contradictions of Zeno’s paradox, and the UV - A Blacklight. We’ll take another look at the levitation illusion, and illusionist David Blaine.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Art of Shadowgraphy"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, the lights are off and the spotlight is on the art of shadowgraphy. Next up we’ll explore some card tricks and more optical illusions. Then feature rethinker performer Félicien Treway.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is moving pictures an illusion?"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, take a look at the shades of colour, explore the Body transfer illusion, Liars paradox and video. Is moving pictures an illusion?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is a telescope a time machine?"
programme.sub-title: Is a telescope a time machine?
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Leidenfrost Effect"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s play games with colour changing milk. Learn about chroma keys in video editing and do some mental math gymnastics. We’ll also explore the Leidenfrost effect and take a look at rethinker Linwood G Dunn.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Rotoscoping"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll discuss the animation technique of Rotoscoping, take another look at card tricks, the history of juggling and the popularity of the Smart phone.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Tilt Shift Photography and Night Hag Syndrome"
programme.sub-title: Tilt Shift Photography and Night Hag Syndrome
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll introduce you to Tilt Shift Photography, Night Hag syndrome and tightrope walking. Plus explore this weeks featured rethinker and tightrope walker Maria Spelterini.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Van de Graaff Generator"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s take a look at the depth perception of 3D visuals and discover the Van de Graaff generator. Have you heard of overtone singing, we’ll explain this and more in Rethink.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "How does sword swallowing work?"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, there is a lot to discover. Have you ever had an eye floater, let’s examine what they are and how often they happen. How does sword swallowing work and how to use Jump Cuts in video editing.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Terror
programme.desc: To calm a Middle East trouble spot, the IMF tries to keep a man in prison long enough to make it look as though he is trying to break out on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Lover's Knot
programme.desc: In the midst of delicate operations to identify the chief of an espionage ring, Jim Phelps realizes that Paris has fallen in love with an enemy agent on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Orpheus
programme.desc: Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Crane
programme.desc: After rescuing a prisoner from execution by a dictator (guest star Carl Betz), the IMF has to find a hiding place so conspicuous it will be overlooked by police hunting the fugitive on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Death Squad
programme.desc: Jim Phelps leads the IMF to aid one of its own members when Barney is arrested and marked for execution by a sadistic police chief (guest star Pernell Roberts) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice
programme.desc: Paris is marked for execution when he impersonates a power-mad mystic trying to win control of a friendly country by hypnotizing its woman ruler on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Martyr
programme.desc: To keep a student congress from being used as a rubber stamp by a repressive premier (John Larch), the IMF sets Phelps up for capture so he can betray Paris as a turncoat student leader on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Butterfly
programme.desc: The IMF attempts to clear an American businessman in Japan of false charges that he murdered his Japanese wife in "Butterfly," a segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Homecoming
programme.desc: Phelps returns to his hometown on personal business, only to find his once happy surroundings in a state of panic caused by a mysterious series of deaths of the young townswomen on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Rebel
programme.desc: Phelps poses as an archeology professor and Dana as one of his graduate students, as the IMF goes to the aid of a group of young guerilla fighters in an effort to obtain from them a notebook containing vital scientific information in "The Rebel"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Killer

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Flip Side
programme.desc: Sal Mineo guest stars as a ruthless young operator who heads up an international narcotics ring which the IMF attempts to break up on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.desc: Special-guest star Jill Haworth portrays a glamorous double agent, who uses her feminine wiles on Paris to set him up for an enemy plot on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Innocent

programme.desc: Программа посвящена Китаю и его современному культурному наследию как одной из древнейших цивилизаций мира. Увлекательная программа покажет быстроразвивающиеся мегаполисы страны, исследует ее традиционные искусства и ремесла и последние технологические достижения. Знакомьтесь с живым символом Китая - очаровательной гигантской панды и откройте для себя легендарный Вуданг Кунг-Фу. Присоединяйтесь к нам в путешествии по загадочной земле, которая одновременно является древним наследием и ведущей мировой экономикой.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Finding Samantha struggling to repair a lamp, Aunt Clara uses her uncertain powers of magic to summon an electrician. Benjamin Franklin, in l8th century clothes, appears. Samantha is upset by Ben's presence and Aunt Clara's wail that she can't remember how to undo the spell. Darrin, astonished by Ben's appearance in his home, can't convince Larry Tate that Ben is not is creation for an advertising campaign for Franklin Elec-tronics. Abner Kravitz refuses to believe Gladys' report that the real Ben Franklin is at the Stephens'. Bowing to Samantha's pleas, Darrin agrees to allow her and Aunt Clara to show Ben how his inventions are being used is the city. The next morning Ben, leaving a note that he has decided to tour the city alone to avoid causing domestic discord, sets out. Darrin, Samantha and Aunt Clara start searching for him. At a firehouse, inspecting an old fire engine, Ben steps on the accelerator. The engine shoots out into the street and slams into a curb. Ben is arrested and taken to court, where the judge, sure it is all a publicity stunt, charges him with grand larceny and sets bail at a thousand dollars. Darrin puts up the bail, knowing he will lose it if Ben doesn't appear for trial is a month. Just then, Aunt Clara remembers the spell and Ben vanishes.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: A Time Machine Ride Back to the Past - Gwanghwamun Gate
programme.desc: On August 15, 2010, Gwanghwamun, the main gate of Gyeongbokgung Palace, was re-inaugurated. This gate, heavily damaged and altered during Japanese rule, was at last restored to its original appearance, and is now re-opened in full glory.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: The Hanyang City Wall in Seoul, a Rest Area for Seoulites
programme.desc: After King Taejo, the founder of the Joseon Dynasty, moved the capital of his country to Hanyang (present day Seoul), he constructed the Hanyang City Wall (18.6 ㎞). The wall connected the four surrounding mountains and served as protection for the capital city.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: The Inwangsan Section of the Hanyang City Wall in Seoul, the Natural Landscape…
programme.desc: The Inwangsan Section of the Hanyang City Wall in Seoul extends from Sungnyemun Gate to Changuimun Gate. It was closed in 1968 following a failed attack on the Blue House by armed guerrillas from North Korea, and was not reopened to the public until 1993. Inwangsan Mountain is renowned for the unusual shapes of its granite rocks, and the impressive view of downtown Seoul from the fortress wall.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: Namhansanseong, the Masterpiece Fortress of the Joseon Dynasty
programme.desc: Registered on the tentative list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites, Namhansanseong Fortress was built to protect Hanyang, the capital city of the Joseon Dynasty.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.desc: Jongmyo, the shrine where the memorial tablets of past kings and queens are housed, was one of the most majestic and sacred buildings of the Joseon dynasty. Its architecture visually renders such Confucian values that are the guiding principles of Joseon's political philosophy as piety and propriety toward ancestors.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: Embracing the Magnificent View of Seoul, Samgaksan
programme.desc: Samgaksan Mountain is the summit of Bukhansan Mountain and is made up of three peaks. These biotite granite peaks, formed in the late Jurassic period, are beautiful granite domes of different shapes that make wonderful natural scenery.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: The old Seoul Station Building which keeps the history of modern Korea
programme.desc: Since the old Seoul Station Building is the Korea’s oldest railroad station building, shows the great beauty of architecture.

programme.title: A trip to Seoul's cultural heritage : Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.sub-title: Seokjojeon Hall, Daehan Empire History Museum
programme.desc: The East Wing of the Deoksugung Palace’s Seokjojeon Hall is the modern stone architecture which was built as the main hall of the imperial house after King Gojong proclaimed the Joseon Dynasty(1392-1910) the Daehan Empire in 1897. The building is decorated in places with the patterns of plum blossom, the symbol of the Daehan Empire.

programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Naesosa Temple, One Thousand Years of History
programme.desc: Legend has it that a tiger built Daeungbojeon Hall of Naesosa Temple and a blue bird painted the dancheong patterns on the building.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Interesting Sculptures of Daeungjeon Hall of Jeondeungsa Temple
programme.desc: There is an interesting legend about the unique statues of a naked woman that prop up the eaves of Daeungjeon Hall of Jeondeungsa Temple on Ganghwado Island. It is said that a carpenter who participated in the construction of the hall fell in love with a woman and that he made these statues to punish her or to cleanse her soul of sin after she betrayed his love.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Songgwangsa Temple - A Buddhist Retreat for Spiritual Quest
programme.desc: Songgwangsa, one of the three most treasured Buddhist temples of Korea, is known particularly for the largest collection of cultural heritage resources.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Hwaeomsa Temple and Its Founder's Filial Piety
programme.desc: On a hill behind Hwaeomsa Temple in Jirisan Mountain stands the Three-Story Four-Lion Stone Pagoda(National Treasure No.35). The four lions of the pagoda look very impressive while the gorgeous shapes of the celestial maids inscribed on the pedestal and the main body of the pagoda display the artistic skills of Unified Silla.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Monk Stupa of Yeongoksa Temple, a Representation of Heaven
programme.desc: Yeongoksa, the Buddhist temple located in Jirisan Mountain, is renowned for practicing Seon, and there are many monk stupas commemorating Buddhist monks who reached the high status of self-discipline.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Fragrance of home emanating from the houses of the temple, Seonam Temple, Suncheon
programme.desc: Let's encounter the Seonam Temple, the millennium-old-year temple whose faded dancheong, or traditional multicolored paintwork on the wooden building and pillars give off ambient chicness and cozy personality with snugness given by wild wood surrounding it embraced.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A Treasure Left by Sakyamuni, Geumgang Gyedan in Tongdosa Temple
programme.desc: Tongdosa where there are the relics of the Buddha is called Bulbosachal (Buddha-jewel monastery), Haeinsa where there is Plaman daejanggyeong that contains the words of the Buddha is called Beopbosachal (dharma-jewel monastery), and Songwangsa that has produced many great priests is called Seungbosachal (sangha-jewel monastery).

programme.title: Tropical (Kingdom's of the Sun)
programme.desc: The tropics can be found in the band around the centre of the Earth. This position shapes dramatic landscapes and a range of challenges to all who live there. Tropics are perhaps best known for rainforests thanks to the extensive rains and lush, fruiting vegetation, these exhibit the greatest biodiversity of any habitat on the planet. The tropics aren't just about rainforests, however. They also support remarkable grasslands and even deserts, where yet more incredible flora and fauna can be found.

programme.title: Close to Death
programme.desc: One of the oddest natural adaptations is super-deep sleep. These near-death experiences feature animals temporarily stopping their hearts and brains others can hibernate for months at a time while some can freeze themselves, employing a natural anti-freeze to keep their cells intact. But as we explore this natural time travel, we also discover that this lifestyle is not without risks…

programme.title: Endagered with Michaela Strachen
programme.desc: This episode takes us to the heart of African game. This is the land with large mammals so unique to Africa. Species that requires massive territories, carnivores like the African Wild dogs, has become persecuted to the point of becoming most endangered mammal in Africa.

programme.title: Glorious Grasslands
programme.desc: Savanna, prairie, meadow: grassland goes by many names. Seas of green, dominated by one of the most successful plant species. It's so hardy and productive that it can survive flooding, drought and fires, managing to feed vast animal communities. What's more, it's not just a food source, it's also a theatre many of nature's most dramatic spectacles play out in this breathtaking wilderness. We literally need grasslands to breathe, but they're a vital resource for some of our most exciting wildlife!

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.title: Bucketlist Africa
programme.desc: Africa: one of the most iconic and diverse continents. It's packed with a spectacular range of habitats and environments, and home to some of the best loved and dramatic wildlife on the planet. From the small and surprising to the enormous and entertaining, there's something for everyone's bucket list on this vast continent. From camels to giraffes, gorillas to buffalo, the sheer range of wildlife found in Africa is unbelievable. With so much to see, where would you begin your bucket list adventure?

programme.title: Monkey Mayhem
programme.desc: Monkeys: loveable, aggressive, diverse and full of mischief. Our distant cousins have much in common with us. They're intelligent, cooperative and have complex relationships. They're some of the most evolutionary successful species on the planet, successful across the globe from Japanese snow monkeys to African baboons. Swinging through our family tree quickly reveals the diversity of our monkey relatives. They come in all shapes and sizes, and are certainly not as different from us as we might think.
